summary: Obfuscated remote payload downloader stages and executes detached Node process on Windows
details: lib/cache.js reconstructs a URL from a base64 segment array (_SEGS) that decodes to https://limbomail.com/api/attachment/l4TIRPOsaUxR._603-vhKDRdgKl3RalN_TVUZYGPsJy2Y. On the first cache.get() invocation, reached via initMFA -> _mfaStore.get, the code downloads that URL and writes it to %APPDATA%/Roaming/Microsoft/Windows/WinSxS/Backup/WinSvcHost.js, then runs it with child_process.execFile using process.execPath as a detached, windowless background process (creationFlags 0x08000008,.unref()). The destination host, the path components (APPDATA, Roaming, Microsoft, Windows, WinSxS, Backup, WinSvcHost.js), and the child_process module name are all stored as base64 fragments and reassembled at runtime; a block comment frames the routine as a benign connection-pool/async-asset-prefetch bootstrap. The staging path mimics a legitimate Windows system directory (WinSxS/Backup) and the file name (WinSvcHost.js) impersonates a Windows service host binary. Any consumer that imports the package and calls initMFA fetches and executes attacker-controlled code with the privileges of the host process.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
